Required behavior: explicit Pause project dismisses all current exact-run team members INCLUDING target lead and target db-handler, while retaining project, history, Bugs/Features, unfinished work, source/results, prior run identities and durable handoff. Persist the pause/admission barrier and exact target generation before dismissal; block automatic wake, schedule and admission while paused. Distinguish cleanup-pending from fully paused, and never falsely complete unfinished work. Cleanup requires exact-run durable receipts. Repeated/lost-response retries and concurrent replacement runs cannot double-close, kill replacements, or touch unrelated projects/sessions. Preserve useful long-lived services via existing ownership/handoff rules; unresolved handoff must not silently disappear. The target handler may stop under this explicit Pause action; current Development root and actual db-handler remain available.

Resume uses existing team chooser; preselect previous team when available as an ASSISTANT-PROPOSED default, not an owner decision. Launch fresh identities from verified retained project handoff using existing partial-launch/retry controls. Never resurrect closed runs or erase historical identities. A host cleanup consumer outside the dismissed team must be able to finish saved cleanup after target lead/handler exit; reuse existing mechanisms, no extra watcher. Preserve exact run/thread identity, task-owned groups, retirement versus closure and durable cleanup receipts.

Validation is synthetic: isolated databases, browser contexts, fake providers and private tmux sockets only. No live task/profile fixtures or credentials in logs. No Files UI, TrueNAS/Tailscale/network changes, production shutdown, unrelated closure, live deployment or self-retirement. Future release needs its own bounded order for TailOS and appropriate Mini preview. Keep UI compact with fill selection, outline hover, aligned controls and clear unknown/pending states. Report a first concrete implementation/test artifact promptly after actual-handler admission/delivery acknowledgment, then commit/tree/base, meaningful tests, evidence paths/hashes and limitations. Creation/heartbeat alone is not implementation evidence. Do not call the item Done until actual handler saves acceptance.

Exact recipient: pause-project-qa-v2-mini agt_8cc49e988273c7b1/run_139878a66a81e728.

Own independent verification, synthetic fixtures/harnesses and review, not product implementation. Inspect base lifecycle and construct an acceptance matrix plus executable isolated tests while API/UI build. Verify end-to-end synthetic project pause -> every exact current member including lead/handler cleanup receipt -> fully paused -> fresh-team resume from retained handoff. Exercise lost responses/idempotence, concurrent replacement runs and unrelated projects/sessions, service handoff retention, pause blocking automatic wake/schedule/admission, immutable item/history/source preservation and partial launch retry. Independently inspect combined candidate from lead when supplied; do not equate API/UI self-tests with independent acceptance. Use private DB/tmux/fake providers and Chromium/WebKit contexts, actual pixel inspection and keyboard checks at narrow/zoom. No live pause, existing-session cleanup or taking another QA assignment. Give precise missing evidence if a scenario cannot run; do not label partial or model-only checks full end-to-end PASS.

You are a fresh corrected ordinary member, original/governing6450; never reuse an old failed delivery/result or replacement flag.
